name: Accordion
description:
The Accordion component is a versatile UI element that allows users to expand and collapse sections of content. It is composed of several primitives that enable customization and flexibility in its usage.

The Accordion component can be used in various contexts, such as displaying FAQs, menus, or any other content that benefits from a collapsible structure. It supports different palettes and usage styles to match the design requirements of your application.

parts.name: ItemGroup
parts.description: An abstraction for rendering all the content-related primitives.

props.name: heading
props.description: The heading content displayed inside the accordion trigger.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: The position of the indicator icon relative to the heading.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Accordion component.

props.name: size
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for size.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the accordion. Useful for composition.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether an accordion item can be closed after it has been expanded.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the expanded accordion items.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of the expanded accordion items. Use when you don't need to control the value of the accordion.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the accordion items are disabled

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The callback fired when the state of expanded/collapsed accordion items changes.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: The callback fired when the focused accordion item changes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the accordion items.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: hideMode
props.description: How to hide content when mounted but not present. - `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive. - `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
